title: 03 · Gestor — resumo da planta
description: Entrega v6 — cinco dashboards. Dados do RDS. Layout v3, painéis nativos. Regras provisórias em REGRAS-DASHBOARDS.md.

options.content:
**Estado atual:** verifique a situação da planta. **Período:** compare quais cabines tiveram mais alertas e mais tempo em risco.

Tempo acumulado soma a duração de cada cabine: duas cabines em risco por 1 hora = 2 horas-cabine. Clique em uma cabine para abrir seu histórico.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(15000) */ * FROM (WITH
raw AS (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE 1=1 AND coletado_em >= FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) - INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND coletado_em <= LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))),
phases AS (SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'A' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_a='ok' THEN fase_a END valor FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'B' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_b='ok' THEN fase_b END valor FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'C' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_c='ok' THEN fase_c END valor FROM raw),
limits AS (
 SELECT *,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(coletado_em) ts,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 60 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.66 END ideal,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 70 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.759 END lim1,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 80 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.8580000000000001 END lim2,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 90 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.957 END lim3
 FROM phases
),
levels AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN valor IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN valor>=lim3 THEN 3 WHEN valor>=lim2 THEN 2 WHEN valor>=lim1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END severity,
 AVG(valor) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) baseline,
 MAX(CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN valor END) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,fase ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) temp_recent,
 LAG(ts) OVER w prev_ts,LEAD(ts) OVER w next_ts,
 LEAD(valor) OVER w next_val,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts DESC,event_id DESC) rn
 FROM limits WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id)
),
flags AS (
 SELECT *,LAG(severity) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id) prev_severity,
 CASE WHEN next_val IS NOT NULL AND valor IS NOT NULL AND next_ts-ts<=5
 THEN GREATEST(0,LEAST(next_ts,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))))-GREATEST(ts,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0)))) ELSE 0 END dt
 FROM levels
),
groups_ AS (
 SELECT *,SUM(CASE WHEN severity>0 AND (COALESCE(prev_severity,0)=0 OR ts-prev_ts>5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
 OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id) grp
 FROM flags
),
marked AS (
 SELECT *,MIN(CASE WHEN severity>0 THEN ts END) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp) event_start
 FROM groups_
),
event_groups AS (
 SELECT cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp,MIN(ts) first_ts,MAX(ts) last_ts,MAX(severity) severity,
 MAX(valor) peak,
 MIN(CASE WHEN ts-event_start>=10 OR (baseline>0 AND valor>=baseline*1.2 AND temp_recent>=70) THEN ts END) confirmed_ts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN severity=3 THEN dt ELSE 0 END) critical_seconds
 FROM marked WHERE severity>0 GROUP BY cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp
),
events AS (
 SELECT * FROM event_groups WHERE confirmed_ts IS NOT NULL AND last_ts>=UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))
),
latest AS (SELECT * FROM levels WHERE rn=1 AND coletado_em>=FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))
SELECT COUNT(*) valor FROM events WHERE severity=3) bounded_query

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(15000) */ * FROM (WITH raw AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE cabine_id='cabine-001' AND tipo='corrente' AND coletado_em BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) AND LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY coletado_em DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 1) r0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE cabine_id='cabine-001' AND tipo='temperatura' AND coletado_em BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) AND LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY coletado_em DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 1) r1 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE cabine_id='cabine-002' AND tipo='corrente' AND coletado_em BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) AND LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY coletado_em DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 1) r2 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE cabine_id='cabine-002' AND tipo='temperatura' AND coletado_em BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) AND LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY coletado_em DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 1) r3 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE cabine_id='cabine-003' AND tipo='corrente' AND coletado_em BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) AND LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY coletado_em DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 1) r4 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE cabine_id='cabine-003' AND tipo='temperatura' AND coletado_em BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) AND LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ORDER BY coletado_em DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 1) r5), phases AS (SELECT cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,CASE WHEN qualidade_a='ok' THEN fase_a END valor FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,CASE WHEN qualidade_b='ok' THEN fase_b END valor FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,CASE WHEN qualidade_c='ok' THEN fase_c END valor FROM raw), latest AS (SELECT *,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(coletado_em) ts,CASE WHEN valor IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN valor >= CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 90 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.957 END THEN 3 WHEN valor >= CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 80 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.8580000000000001 END THEN 2 WHEN valor >= CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 70 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.759 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END severity FROM phases), inventory AS (SELECT 'cabine-001' cabine_id UNION SELECT 'cabine-002' cabine_id UNION SELECT 'cabine-003' cabine_id), current_state AS (
 SELECT i.cabine_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(l.valor)<6 OR MAX(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)))-l.ts)>60 THEN -1 ELSE MAX(l.severity) END estado,
 MAX(CASE WHEN tipo='corrente' THEN valor END) corrente,
 MAX(CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN valor END) temperatura
 FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.cabine_id=i.cabine_id GROUP BY i.cabine_id)
 SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(estado=-1)>0 THEN 'Dados incompletos' WHEN MAX(estado)=3 THEN 'Crítico' WHEN MAX(estado)=2 THEN 'Moderado' WHEN MAX(estado)=1 THEN 'Atenção' ELSE 'Normal' END Estado FROM current_state) bounded_query

panels.title: Tempo acumulado em risco
panels.description: União temporal entre fases e tipos em alerta, por cabine; soma entre cabines. Não equivale à duração de risco da planta nem a indisponibilidade.

event_groups AS (
 SELECT cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp,MIN(ts) first_ts,MAX(ts) last_ts,MAX(severity) severity,
 MAX(valor) peak,
 MIN(CASE WHEN ts-event_start>=10 OR (baseline>0 AND valor>=baseline*1.2 AND temp_recent>=70) THEN ts END) confirmed_ts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN severity=3 THEN dt ELSE 0 END) critical_seconds
 FROM marked WHERE severity>0 GROUP BY cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp
),
events AS (
 SELECT * FROM event_groups WHERE confirmed_ts IS NOT NULL AND last_ts>=UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))
),
latest AS (SELECT * FROM levels WHERE rn=1 AND coletado_em>=FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))
, risk_intervals AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT cabine_id,GREATEST(ts,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))) a,
 LEAST(next_ts,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)))) z
 FROM flags WHERE severity>0 AND dt>0
 ), previous_end AS (
 SELECT *,MAX(z) OVER(PARTITION BY cabine_id ORDER BY a,z
 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) prev_end FROM risk_intervals
 ), islands AS (
 SELECT *,SUM(CASE WHEN prev_end IS NULL OR a>prev_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
 OVER(PARTITION BY cabine_id ORDER BY a,z ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) island FROM previous_end
 ), merged AS (
 SELECT cabine_id,island,MAX(z)-MIN(a) seconds FROM islands GROUP BY cabine_id,island
 ), exposure AS (SELECT cabine_id,SUM(seconds) seconds FROM merged GROUP BY cabine_id)
 SELECT cabine_id Cabine,seconds/3600 Horas FROM exposure ORDER BY seconds DESC) bounded_query

SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(15000) */ * FROM (WITH
raw AS (SELECT * FROM leituras WHERE 1=1 AND coletado_em >= FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0) - INTERVAL 60 SECOND AND coletado_em <= LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))),
phases AS (SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'A' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_a='ok' THEN fase_a END valor FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'B' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_b='ok' THEN fase_b END valor FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT event_id,cabine_id,tipo,coletado_em,recebido_em,'C' fase,CASE WHEN qualidade_c='ok' THEN fase_c END valor FROM raw),
limits AS (
 SELECT *,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(coletado_em) ts,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 60 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.66 END ideal,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 70 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.759 END lim1,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 80 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.8580000000000001 END lim2,
 CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN 90 ELSE (CASE cabine_id WHEN 'cabine-001' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-002' THEN 600.0 WHEN 'cabine-003' THEN 600.0 ELSE 600.0 END)*0.957 END lim3
 FROM phases
),
levels AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN valor IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN valor>=lim3 THEN 3 WHEN valor>=lim2 THEN 2 WHEN valor>=lim1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END severity,
 AVG(valor) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) baseline,
 MAX(CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN valor END) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,fase ORDER BY ts RANGE BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) temp_recent,
 LAG(ts) OVER w prev_ts,LEAD(ts) OVER w next_ts,
 LEAD(valor) OVER w next_val,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts DESC,event_id DESC) rn
 FROM limits WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id)
),
flags AS (
 SELECT *,LAG(severity) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id) prev_severity,
 CASE WHEN next_val IS NOT NULL AND valor IS NOT NULL AND next_ts-ts<=5
 THEN GREATEST(0,LEAST(next_ts,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))))-GREATEST(ts,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0)))) ELSE 0 END dt
 FROM levels
),
groups_ AS (
 SELECT *,SUM(CASE WHEN severity>0 AND (COALESCE(prev_severity,0)=0 OR ts-prev_ts>5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
 OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase ORDER BY ts,event_id) grp
 FROM flags
),
marked AS (
 SELECT *,MIN(CASE WHEN severity>0 THEN ts END) OVER (PARTITION BY cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp) event_start
 FROM groups_
),
event_groups AS (
 SELECT cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp,MIN(ts) first_ts,MAX(ts) last_ts,MAX(severity) severity,
 MAX(valor) peak,
 MIN(CASE WHEN ts-event_start>=10 OR (baseline>0 AND valor>=baseline*1.2 AND temp_recent>=70) THEN ts END) confirmed_ts,
 SUM(CASE WHEN severity=3 THEN dt ELSE 0 END) critical_seconds
 FROM marked WHERE severity>0 GROUP BY cabine_id,tipo,fase,grp
),
events AS (
 SELECT * FROM event_groups WHERE confirmed_ts IS NOT NULL AND last_ts>=UNIX_TIMESTAMP(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))
),
latest AS (SELECT * FROM levels WHERE rn=1 AND coletado_em>=FROM_UNIXTIME(${__from}/1000.0))
SELECT cabine_id Cabine,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(valor)<6 OR MAX(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LEAST(FROM_UNIXTIME(${__to}/1000.0), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)))-ts)>60 THEN 'Sem dados recentes' WHEN MAX(severity)=3 THEN 'Crítico' WHEN MAX(severity)=2 THEN 'Moderado' WHEN MAX(severity)=1 THEN 'Atenção' ELSE 'Normal' END Estado,
 MAX(CASE WHEN tipo='corrente' THEN valor END) Corrente_A,
 MAX(CASE WHEN tipo='temperatura' THEN valor END) Temperatura_C
 FROM latest GROUP BY cabine_id ORDER BY MAX(severity) DESC) bounded_query
SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(15000) */ * FROM (SELECT 'Sem registro operacional' Estado) bounded_query
SELECT /*+ MAX_EXECUTION_TIME(15000) */ * FROM (SELECT 'Sem registro de operação' Estado) bounded_query
